remoteConnect.desc_lan: Connect via local network. Both devices must be on the same LAN/WiFi. If connection fails, check router security settings (such as AP/client isolation) and make sure proxy/tunneling settings do not route or block LAN traffic (allow direct LAN access) on both devices.
remoteConnect.desc_openbitfun_server: Connect via OpenBitFun relay server. The server is currently self-hosted by the OpenBitFun team and is mainly provided for convenient trials and feature evaluation. Although message payloads are protected with end-to-end encryption, the relay service and related infrastructure may still observe necessary metadata, and any public-facing service can introduce information security or data leakage risks due to misconfiguration, log exposure, operational mistakes, or attacks. For long-term use, production environments, or higher-security scenarios, we strongly recommend using a self-hosted server under your own deployment and operational control.
remoteConnect.desc_bot: Connect via Feishu, Telegram, or WeChat (iLink) bot. Complete the setup for your chosen channel below.

remoteConnect.botWeixinRestriction: WeChat ClawBot limits the bot to 10 replies within 24 hours after the user sends a message. Split long replies also consume the quota. When the window or quota ends, send another message in WeChat to reactivate it.

remoteConnect.disclaimerIntro: Remote Connect lets you control OpenBitFun on other devices remotely or send tasks from a phone, browser, or chat app. Read and understand the following before enabling it:
remoteConnect.disclaimerFullDetails: View complete security, privacy, network, and compliance details
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemGeneralRisk: Remote operations and tasks may read or modify files or run commands on the selected device and workspace. Check the target and permissions; incorrect operations, software defects, or connection failures may cause data loss or other damage.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemSecurity: Devices, phones, and browsers connect through the same OpenBitFun account. Chat apps use their own authorization and pairing flows. Sign in only on trusted devices and grant control only to people you trust.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemEncryption: Control messages and task data between devices use end-to-end encryption over the official or LAN relay. Metadata such as account identifiers, device names, online status, and connection addresses is outside the encrypted message payload. Chat app channels are not covered by this layer of end-to-end encryption.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemOpenSource: OpenBitFun's Remote Connect encryption implementation is fully open-source. You are free to audit the source code to verify its security.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemPrivacy: Task content, attachments, and results may contain sensitive information and appear on connected clients or in chat histories. Device logs, browsers, and connected third-party services may also retain data. Limit what you send and who can access it.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemDataUsage: OpenBitFun does not use your Remote Connect message content for model training or commercial data exploitation. Model services and chat platforms you connect, such as Feishu, Telegram, and WeChat, may process data under their own terms.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemCredentials: Protect your OpenBitFun account, device and browser sign-in credentials, and chat app credentials such as tokens and app secrets. Leaked credentials or stolen devices may let others submit tasks or access data.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemQrCode: Connection QR codes and links contain the relay address and target device identifier. Opening them still requires signing in with the same OpenBitFun account. Avoid sharing them with unrelated parties and verify the address and target device before signing in or connecting.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemRelay: Official and LAN relays connect devices and forward messages; tasks run on the execution device, which must remain online. Closing the connection window or cancelling an invitation does not disconnect an established account connection. Disconnect it explicitly in connection management.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemNetwork: LAN connections require devices to reach each other; router isolation, firewalls, and proxy settings may block access. The official relay also depends on internet and service availability. Network changes may cause interruptions or delays.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemBot: Chat app pairing codes establish a connection to the execution device so you can send tasks from the chat app. Do not share codes with unrelated parties, and check chat accounts, group membership, and platform permissions.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemBotPersistence: Chat app credentials and pairing information are saved on the execution device to restore connections after a restart. Protect that device and its configuration files, and disconnect when access is no longer needed.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemMobileBrowser: Phones and browsers may retain sign-in credentials, page caches, and task content. Screenshots, clipboards, and extensions may also expose information. Do not remain signed in on shared or untrusted devices.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemCompliance: Some countries or regions have legal restrictions on encrypted communication, tunneling services, cross-border data transfer, and related activities. Please evaluate compliance with your local laws and regulations, including potential policy changes.
remoteConnect.disclaimerItemLiability: Any risks, losses, disputes, or other adverse consequences arising during your use of Remote Connect (including but not limited to data leakage, service interruption, account anomalies, or service unavailability) are your responsibility; OpenBitFun is not liable for resulting issues.

dispatch.baseRefHint: Uses HEAD by default. You can also enter a branch, tag, or commit from this repository.
dispatch.baseRefInvalid: "{{ref}}" was not found in this repository. Check the branch, tag, or commit and try again.
dispatch.includeUncommittedHint: Only Git-visible changes are sent. Ignored files, including local .env files and build output, stay on this device.
dispatch.provisioningDaemon: Syncing the account and starting the service…
dispatch.cliUpdateRequired: Needs an update before it can run tasks
dispatch.cliUnavailable: OpenBitFun is not installed on this target
dispatch.deviceUpdateRequired: Update OpenBitFun on this device, then check again.
dispatch.oneClickDeployDescription: Installs the signature-verified OpenBitFun CLI. If this device is signed in, it also syncs the current account and starts an auto-start service.
dispatch.prepareSucceededWithAccount: OpenBitFun CLI is installed, the account was synced securely, and the persistent service is connected.
dispatch.prepareSucceededCliOnly: OpenBitFun CLI is installed. Account sync was skipped because this device is signed out; SSH Dispatch tasks still run as persistent background processes.
dispatch.prepareFailed: OpenBitFun setup did not complete. Failed account and service changes are cleaned up on a best-effort basis; check the target connection or service manager and try again.
dispatch.prepareCancelFailed: Setup could not be cancelled. Check the target status again shortly.
dispatch.retryProvisionDescription: The CLI is ready. Retry only the secure account sync and persistent service setup.
dispatch.installUnavailable: No compatible OpenBitFun package is available for this target, so it cannot run tasks. Pick another target, or install OpenBitFun on it yourself and check again.
dispatch.eventHistoryIncomplete: Some task history is no longer available. The visible conversation may be incomplete.
dispatch.syncSubtitle: Bring the latest remote task changes to this device without modifying your current workspace.
dispatch.syncSubtitleWithTarget: Bring the latest changes from {{target}} to this device without modifying your current workspace.
dispatch.syncBaselineMissing: The local copy used to receive changes was deleted, so OpenBitFun cannot fetch them automatically. Handle the result on the target instead.
dispatch.syncSucceeded: Fetched {{count}} commit(s). Your current workspace was not modified.
dispatch.syncNoFileList: The commits were fetched, but the changed-file list is unavailable.
dispatch.syncChangesTruncated: Only some files are shown. All commits were fetched.
dispatch.syncNoChanges: There are no new remote changes.
dispatch.syncFailed: Could not get remote changes. Make sure the target is online and the repository is available, then try again.
